About JCH

A family shop with decades of experience.

JCH Auto Works is a family-owned and operated auto body repair business on Route 21 in Palmyra, New York.

Our story

New sign. Experienced hands.

JCH Auto Works is a recently established business built on more than 30 years of auto body expertise.

Honest estimates, real communication with customers and insurers, and repairs we stand behind for as long as you own the vehicle. And you deal with family, not a call center.
